[Thinking]
**Crafting an illustration prompt**

I need to create a prompt for an AI image generator to illustrate an appeal for financial contributions to a magazine. It’ll be helpful to ask clarifying questions, but I might present multiple variants first. I can gather details like the magazine’s name, target audience, and desired style. Imagery ideas could include hands donating or a piggy bank, and I should think about the tone and any text overlays too. Finally, I want to provide a ready-to-use prompt with options for different AI tools.**Developing a magazine prompt**

I’m looking to create a primary prompt for an illustration, using placeholders for the magazine name, brand colors, and tone. I want to offer different versions, like warm human-centric or symbolic styles, alongside flat vector options or photo-realistic still lifes. It’ll be useful to include guidance for text overlays and layout zones. I’ll produce a structured prompt that includes a title, description, negative prompts, and specific parameters for Midjourney and Stable Diffusion. Plus, I should ensure there’s background space for headlines and donate buttons.
[/Thinking]

Here are ready-to-use prompts you can copy into most AI image generators. They’re tailored for an illustration that invites financial contributions to support a magazine. Use the “Core Prompt” as-is or pick a style variant. Replace bracketed items with your details (magazine name, brand colors, etc.).

Core prompt (editorial illustration, warm and trustworthy)
- Prompt: “An uplifting editorial illustration showing a diverse reader community supporting [Magazine Name] through small contributions: open magazine pages radiating soft light, subtle icons of journalism (pen, microphone, printing press) floating like constellations, gentle hands placing small coins and digital hearts into a shared jar labeled ‘Support Independent Journalism’. Clean composition with generous white/negative space for headline and CTA on the right. Palette aligns with [Brand Colors], warm highlights, friendly, modern, optimistic, approachable. Vector-meets-hand-drawn texture, minimal clutter, high legibility, suitable for web and print banners. Focus on hope, impact, and community rather than urgency.”
- Negative prompt: “no harsh shadows, no corporate stock-photo vibe, no political imagery, no currency logos, no messy typography, no busy background, no dark/grungy mood”
- Suggested aspect ratio: 3:2 or 16:9
- Focal area: left/middle; leave clean space on right for copy

Style variants (choose one if you prefer a different look)
1) Flat vector, bold and simple
- “Flat vector illustration, bright yet refined palette using [Brand Colors]. Open magazine as a central icon, simple rounded shapes of people contributing (coins, small hearts, ‘subscribe’ buttons), subtle dotted lines connecting them to the magazine. Generous negative space for headline ‘Support [Magazine Name]’ and a donate button area. Crisp, high-contrast, accessible, ADA-friendly color contrast, minimal detail, no gradients.”
- Negative: “no tiny text, no gradients, no photorealism, no clutter”

2) Collage/printmaking vibe
- “Textured collage illustration inspired by risograph/printmaking: layered paper textures, halftone dots, overlapping shapes of an open magazine, envelopes, and a jar marked ‘Support’. Warm reds/blues/creams adapted to [Brand Colors]. Imperfect edges, tactile feel, community energy. Space reserved at top-right for headline and short body copy.”
- Negative: “no glossy 3D, no sharp digital lighting, no realism”

3) Watercolor, human-centered
- “Soft watercolor illustration: a table with an open magazine, a small donation jar, a phone showing a ‘Contribute’ screen, and hands of varied ages/tones reaching in support. Ambient morning light, calm hope, gentle textures. Subtle icons of truth and storytelling drifting above the pages. Clean right-side area for text.”
- Negative: “no dark mood, no messy brush splatter, no tiny unreadable details”

4) Modern editorial spot illustration
- “Contemporary editorial spot: symbolic heart-shaped bookmark tucked inside an open magazine; small coins and digital icons orbiting it. Minimal lines, restrained palette in [Brand Colors], soft drop shadows, high whitespace. Designed to crop for social media.”
- Negative: “no busy background, no photorealism”

Optional text overlay (add in your design tool, not the image prompt)
- Headline ideas: “Support Independent Journalism”, “Power Our Reporting”, “Help Keep [Magazine Name] Ad-Free”
- Subhead: “Your contribution—of any size—keeps thoughtful reporting accessible.”
- CTA button: “Contribute” or “Donate Now”

Platform-specific tips
- Midjourney: append “--ar 3:2 --stylize 300”
- Stable Diffusion/SDXL: Steps 30–40, CFG 6–7, Sampler DPM++ 2M, Size 1536x1024, Seed random, Hires fix on
- DALL·E: paste prompt as-is; generate several and pick the cleanest composition

If you share a few details—magazine name, audience, brand colors, tone (earnest, bold, gentle), and where it will be used (web hero, print cover, social)—I can tailor a final single prompt and layout notes exactly to your needs.
